title.zh-CN: 双眼间断上斜、运动发育落后 · 6月龄男婴
title.en: Intermittent upward eye deviation and motor delay · 6-month-old boy

summary.zh-CN: 6月龄男婴20多天来双眼时常向上斜，至今抬头不稳，家长带他住院检查。
summary.en: A 6-month-old boy whose eyes have kept turning upwards for over 20 days, and who still cannot hold his head steady, is admitted for assessment.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例病例报告改编。1.1.0版依据1.0.0版已记录的事实重写：6月龄男婴，双眼间断上斜20余天；抬头不稳，不会翻身、独坐或主动抓物；喜饮水约1200 mL/日、夜尿多；生后前3个月少哭、吃奶后即睡、每日睡约22小时；过期妊娠且无羊水，孕43周加1天剖宫产，出生体重4.5 kg；孕中期母亲感冒发热、治疗3天好转；父母非近亲；入院查体（不能注视追视、强光无瞬目，瞳孔左3 mm右4 mm且直接间接对光反射消失，四肢肌张力低，不能竖头、翻身、独坐，对声音有反应但定位不灵敏，阴茎约1 cm、双侧阴囊饱满、无隐睾）；眼底、视觉与听觉诱发电位、头颅磁共振、尿比重、电解质与肾功能、血糖、生长激素、甲状腺功能和Gesell评估结果；报告的诊断、处理和9个月复查。体重8.5 kg只见于1.0.0版的患者资料。这些事实尚未对照原文全文核对。患儿姓名为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。陪同的家长（是父亲还是母亲未记录）、全部对话、阶段、决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点为教学设计；1.0.0未记录的内容保持未知。保留的矛盾和疑点：后一项生长激素值10.06 nmol/L与报告的“生长激素缺乏”判断不一致；生长激素以nmol/L报告；眼底描述为视神经萎缩而磁共振为视神经纤细。1.0.0称这些内容“原病例资料没有说明”，本版改为“没有记录”，不再对原文作出断言。
notes.en: Adapted from one published single-case report. Version 1.1.0 is re-authored from the facts version 1.0.0 records: a 6-month-old boy with intermittent upward deviation of both eyes for over 20 days; poor head control, unable to roll, sit or grasp objects of his own accord; likes drinking water, about 1200 mL a day, with heavy night-time urine; in his first three months he rarely cried, slept after feeds and slept about 22 hours a day; a post-term pregnancy without amniotic fluid, caesarean at 43 weeks and 1 day, birth weight 4.5 kg; a febrile cold in the mother in mid-pregnancy, better after three days of treatment; non-consanguineous parents; the admission examination (no fixing or following, no blink to bright light, pupils left 3 mm and right 4 mm with absent direct and consensual reflexes, reduced limb tone, no head control, rolling or sitting, a response to sound with poor localisation, a penis of about 1 cm with full scrotal sacs and no undescended testis); the fundoscopy, visual and auditory evoked potentials, brain MRI, urine specific gravity, electrolytes and renal function, glucose, GH, thyroid and Gesell results; the report's diagnosis, management and 9-month review. The 8.5 kg weight appears only in 1.0.0's patient card. These facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The baby's name is a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and times are relative. The parent (whether mother or father is not recorded), all dialogue, the phases, decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design; what 1.0.0 does not record stays unknown. Inconsistencies kept: the later GH value of 10.06 nmol/L does not fit the report's reading of GH deficiency; GH is reported in nmol/L; the fundi are described as optic atrophy while the MRI shows thin optic nerves. Version 1.0.0 said such details were 'not provided by the source case'; this version says they are not recorded, without a claim about the article.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 从不注视、强光不眨眼和对光反射消失识别前部视路病变，并把小阴茎、多饮夜尿和早期嗜睡与下丘脑-垂体功能障碍联系起来。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise anterior visual pathway disease from absent fixing, blink to light and pupil reflexes, and link a micropenis, heavy drinking with much urine at night and early sleepiness to hypothalamic–pituitary dysfunction.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把透明隔缺如合并视神经、视交叉细小解读为视隔发育不良，并据此安排全部垂体轴的评估和定期复查，皮质醇优先。
learningOutcomes.en: Read an absent septum pellucidum with thin optic nerves and chiasm as septo-optic dysplasia and arrange assessment and re-assessment of every pituitary axis, cortisol first.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按RCH 2022尿崩症指南安全评估婴儿的可疑精氨酸加压素缺乏：随时饮水、绝不限水、配对血尿渗透压，禁水试验只在专科监测下进行。
learningOutcomes.en: Assess suspected arginine vasopressin deficiency in an infant safely, as the RCH 2022 diabetes insipidus guideline sets out: free water, no restriction, paired blood and urine osmolality, and a deprivation test only under specialist monitoring.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按PES 2016（为使成年身高正常、避免极度矮小而强烈推荐治疗）为生长激素缺乏制定治疗计划：先查清肾上腺轴，用药后重新评估肾上腺轴和甲状腺轴。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan GH treatment for GH deficiency in line with PES 2016 (a strong recommendation to treat, to normalise adult height and avoid extreme shortness), clearing the adrenal axis first and re-assessing the adrenal and thyroid axes after starting.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为证实ACTH缺乏的婴儿制定BSPED 2023应急方案（应激加量、应急卡、1岁以下肌注氢化可的松25 mg），并按PES 2015的阈值监测血糖。
learningOutcomes.en: Set up the BSPED 2023 emergency plan for an infant with confirmed ACTH deficiency (sick-day doses, an emergency card, IM hydrocortisone 25 mg under one year) and monitor glucose against the PES 2015 thresholds.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 不加修改地保留并核实报告中前后矛盾的化验值，并用Calgary–Cambridge结构向家长说明诊断、风险和不确定性。
learningOutcomes.en: Keep and verify a contradictory published laboratory value without editing it, and explain the diagnosis, the risks and the uncertainty to the parents using the Calgary–Cambridge structure.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 这20多天两只眼睛老往上斜，到现在头还抬不稳。
chiefComplaint.en: For over 20 days his eyes keep turning upwards, and he still can't hold his head up properly.

triageNote.zh-CN: 6月龄男婴，家长陪同收入儿科病房。双眼间断上斜20余天；至今抬头不稳，不会翻身，也不能独坐。
triageNote.en: 6-month-old boy admitted to the paediatric ward with a parent. Intermittent upward deviation of both eyes for over 20 days; he still cannot hold his head steady, roll over or sit unsupported.

personality.zh-CN: 6月龄的男婴，不会说话。陪同的家长焦急又困惑：孩子的眼睛老往上斜，到现在还抬不稳头；被问到时如实回答，不知道的就直说。
personality.en: A 6-month-old baby boy who cannot speak. The parent with him is anxious and puzzled — his eyes keep turning up and he still cannot hold his head steady — and answers truthfully when asked, saying plainly what they do not know.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 家长用日常口语、短句回答，说得出孩子每天大概喝多少水、小时候睡多久；检查结果请医生看报告；不知道的就说说不上来。
speechStyle.en: The parent answers in short, everyday sentences, can say roughly how much he drinks and how long he slept as a newborn, leaves results to the doctors' reports, and says plainly when they don't know.

openingLine.zh-CN: （家长）医生，孩子这20多天两只眼睛老往上斜，都6个月了，头还抬不稳，您给好好看看。
openingLine.en: (Parent) Doctor, for over 20 days his eyes have kept turning upwards, and at six months he still can't hold his head up — please have a good look at him.

concerns.zh-CN: 他的眼睛到底能不能看见东西？
他以后能跟上别的孩子吗？
concerns.en: Will he ever catch up with other children?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 婴儿：不会说话，躺在小床上；不要描述病例没有给出的行为或体征。家长：守在床边，焦急但配合；只回答被问到的内容；被问到检查结果或诊断时，说要听医生的；没有把握的事直说不知道，不要编。
actingNotes.en: Baby: cannot speak, lying in his cot; do not describe any behaviour or sign the case does not give. Parent: at the cot side, anxious but cooperative; answers only what is asked; asked about results or the diagnosis, says that is for the doctors; says plainly when unsure — never invents it.

persona.zh-CN: 孩子的家长（是父亲还是母亲未记录），陪孩子住院。焦急，有些困惑，说话直白，用日常说法；知道孩子出生和头几个月的情况，说得出每天大概喝多少水；检查结果请医生看报告；不知道的直说，不替别人猜。
persona.en: The baby's parent (whether mother or father is not recorded), staying with him in hospital. Anxious and a little bewildered, speaks plainly in everyday words; knows how the birth and his first months went and can say roughly how much he drinks; leaves results to the doctors' reports; says plainly when they don't know and never guesses.

nonVerbalReason.en: a 6-month-old infant; his parent answers the history

description.zh-CN: 6月龄男婴因双眼间断上斜20余天、运动发育落后，由家长陪同收入儿科病房。向家长采集病史并查体，开始评估，作答决策 1；之后入院检查的报告陆续可调阅。
description.en: A 6-month-old boy is admitted to the paediatric ward with a parent because his eyes have turned upwards on and off for over 20 days and his motor development is behind. Take the history from his parent, examine him, start the assessment and answer decision 1; the admission tests' reports then become available.

description.zh-CN: 眼底检查、视觉与听觉诱发电位、头颅磁共振，以及尿液和血液检查的报告已可调阅（各项检查的日期未记录）。作答决策 2 和决策 3 后，内分泌和发育评估的报告开放。
description.en: The fundoscopy, visual and auditory evoked potential, brain MRI, urine and blood reports can now be read (their dates are not recorded). Once decisions 2 and 3 are answered, the endocrine and developmental reports open.

description.zh-CN: 生长激素检测、甲状腺功能和Gesell发育评估的报告已可调阅（日期未记录）。作答决策 4 和决策 5 并安排好出院后的转介后，报告记录的处理和9个月复查开放。
description.en: The growth hormone, thyroid function and Gesell developmental reports can now be read (their dates are not recorded). Once decisions 4 and 5 are answered and the referrals for after discharge are arranged, the report's management and the 9-month review open.

label.zh-CN: 报告记录的处理与9个月复查

description.zh-CN: 报告记录的诊断与处理，以及9个月复查时的发育、生长和甲状腺功能。
description.en: The diagnosis and management as the report records them, and his development, growth and thyroid function at the 9-month review.

text.en: The report's diagnosis: septo-optic dysplasia with growth hormone deficiency; central diabetes insipidus was not confirmed. Growth hormone replacement was not given — the report cites his height range at the time and the family's finances — and monitoring was planned. At the 9-month review: developmental quotient 20; length 69 cm, weight 9 kg; thyroid function normal. source.en: Recorded in the report (not yet checked against the full article): diagnosis of septo-optic dysplasia with GH deficiency; central DI unconfirmed; no GH replacement (reasons including the height range at the time and family finances), monitoring requested; at the 9-month review DQ 20, length 69 cm, weight 9 kg, thyroid function normal

name.zh-CN: 随时饮水并记录出入量（称尿布）
name.en: Free access to water with an intake–output chart (weighed nappies)

dose.zh-CN: 他自己拿不到水、也不会要水：随时、经常给他喂水，绝不限制饮水；护士记录每次喂奶和饮水量，称重尿布计算尿量，每天称体重。
dose.en: Offer him water freely and often, since he cannot reach for a drink or ask for one, and never restrict it; the nurses chart every feed and drink, weigh the nappies for urine output and weigh him daily.

response.zh-CN: 已安排：随时、经常给他喂水，护士开始记录出入量并称重尿布。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Arranged: water is offered to him freely and often, and the nurses start an intake–output chart with weighed nappies. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 每次喂奶前测末梢血糖；低于3.3 mmol/L（60 mg/dL，PES 2015对婴儿进一步评估的阈值）时，立即送检静脉血糖并报告医生，由医生决定关键标本的留取。
dose.en: A capillary glucose before each feed; below 3.3 mmol/L (60 mg/dL, the PES 2015 threshold for evaluating an infant), send a laboratory glucose and tell the doctor at once, who decides on the critical sample.

response.zh-CN: 已开始喂奶前测血糖。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其读数。
response.en: Pre-feed glucose checks started. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate the readings.

dose.zh-CN: 评估全部垂体轴，指导水平衡评估、生长激素计划和肾上腺危象预案。
dose.en: Assess every pituitary axis and guide the water-balance work-up, the GH plan and the adrenal-crisis plan.

response.zh-CN: 会诊已安排。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Consultation arranged. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 肾上腺危象预案（证实ACTH缺乏后启用）
name.en: Adrenal-crisis plan, to start if ACTH deficiency is confirmed

dose.zh-CN: 证实缺乏后：每日氢化可的松替代；生病时按BSPED 2023加量（中重度疾病约30 mg/m²/日，分4次）；随身应急卡；不能口服或出现危象时，1岁以下婴儿肌注氢化可的松25 mg并立即送医，随后静脉2 mg/kg（最多100 mg）每4–6小时一次。
dose.en: Once deficiency is confirmed: daily hydrocortisone replacement; sick-day doses per BSPED 2023 (about 30 mg/m²/day in four doses for moderate to severe illness); an emergency card; if he cannot take it by mouth or shows a crisis, IM hydrocortisone 25 mg for an infant under one year and straight to hospital, then 2 mg/kg IV (maximum 100 mg) every 4–6 hours.

response.zh-CN: 预案已写好，待皮质醇结果证实缺乏后启用。本病例没有记录皮质醇结果，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Plan written, to start if the cortisol result shows a deficiency. This case records no cortisol result and does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 转介儿童眼科随访与视觉康复
name.en: Paediatric ophthalmology follow-up and vision habilitation referral

dose.zh-CN: 儿童眼科定期随访；转介视觉障碍早期干预（低视力评估与视觉训练）。
dose.en: Regular paediatric ophthalmology review; referral to early intervention for visual impairment (low-vision assessment and habilitation).

response.zh-CN: 转介已安排。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Referral made. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 转介早期干预与康复训练
name.en: Referral for early intervention and developmental therapy

dose.zh-CN: 儿童康复/发育团队评估运动和整体发育，制定以视觉障碍为前提的训练计划，并安排神经发育随访。
dose.en: Child development team assessment of motor and overall development, a therapy plan built around his visual impairment, and neurodevelopmental follow-up.

response.zh-CN: 转介已安排。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Referral made. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 暂缓生长激素，定期随访身长
name.en: Defer growth hormone and follow his length

dose.zh-CN: 暂不用生长激素；定期测量身长和体重，出现生长减速时再考虑治疗。
dose.en: No growth hormone for now; measure length and weight regularly and consider treatment if growth slows.

response.zh-CN: 已记入计划。本病例不模拟其效果；报告的做法在结局记录中开放。
response.en: Entered in the plan. The case does not simulate the effect; what the report did opens with the outcome record.

name.zh-CN: 开始每日皮下注射生长激素

dose.zh-CN: 每日皮下注射，剂量由儿科内分泌医生确定；开始后复查FT4和皮质醇。
dose.en: Daily subcutaneous injection at the dose set by paediatric endocrinology; recheck free T4 and cortisol after starting.

harm.zh-CN: 现在不能开始：本病例没有皮质醇结果，后一项10.06 nmol/L的生长激素值也未核实。生长激素会加快皮质醇代谢、促进T4转化为T3，可使潜在的肾上腺皮质功能不全或中枢性甲减显现；对可能缺乏ACTH的婴儿，这意味着肾上腺危象的风险（BSPED 2023）。PES 2016为使成年身高正常而强烈推荐治疗生长激素缺乏，并建议由儿科内分泌医生负责：诊断成立、肾上腺轴查清（缺乏者先替代）后再开始，开始后重新评估肾上腺轴和甲状腺轴。
harm.en: Not now: this case has no cortisol result, and the later GH value of 10.06 nmol/L is unverified. GH speeds cortisol metabolism and T4-to-T3 conversion and can unmask a latent adrenal insufficiency or central hypothyroidism — in an infant who may lack ACTH, a risk of adrenal crisis (BSPED 2023). PES 2016 strongly recommends treating GH deficiency to normalise adult height and leaves it to paediatric endocrinologists: they start GH once the diagnosis stands and the adrenal axis is clear (replaced first if deficient), then re-assess the adrenal and thyroid axes.

response.zh-CN: 已开始。本病例不模拟其效果；报告的做法在结局记录中开放。
response.en: Started. The case does not simulate the effect; what the report did opens with the outcome record.

dose.zh-CN: 左甲状腺素口服，每日一次。

harm.zh-CN: 没有测得的低FT4就不补甲状腺素：中枢性甲减要看FT4（TSH可以正常）。皮质醇轴未明时补甲状腺素会加快皮质醇清除，可能诱发肾上腺危象——BSPED 2023所述的急症；中枢性甲减确诊后，也要在肾上腺轴查清（缺乏者先用氢化可的松）后再开始。
harm.en: No thyroxine without a measured low free T4: central hypothyroidism is judged on the free T4, since the TSH can be normal. Given while the cortisol axis is unknown, thyroxine speeds cortisol clearance and can precipitate an adrenal crisis — the emergency BSPED 2023 sets out; even with proven central hypothyroidism it starts only once the adrenal axis is clear (hydrocortisone first if deficient).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录使用左甲状腺素，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record levothyroxine and does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 去氨加压素口服，按夜尿减少的情况逐步加量。
dose.en: Oral desmopressin, increased until the night-time urine falls.

harm.zh-CN: 危险：加压素缺乏还没有证实。去氨加压素使肾脏排不出多余的水，而他饮水量大，可迅速发生稀释性低钠血症和抽搐。RCH 2022要求先在专科指导下明确诊断（随时饮水、配对查血钠、血浆和尿渗透压）；确诊后由儿科内分泌医生小剂量起用并监测血钠。
harm.en: Dangerous: vasopressin deficiency is not proven. Desmopressin stops the kidneys clearing excess water, and he drinks a great deal, so dilutional hyponatraemia and seizures can follow quickly. RCH 2022 asks for the diagnosis to be made under specialist guidance first (free water, a paired sodium, plasma and urine osmolality); once confirmed, paediatric endocrinology starts a low dose with sodium monitoring.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录使用去氨加压素，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record desmopressin and does not simulate its effect.

name.en: Ask the parents to restrict his water at home

dose.zh-CN: 请家长在家把每天的饮水量减到同龄婴儿的正常范围，两周后复查尿比重。
dose.en: Ask the parents to cut his daily water to the normal range for his age at home and recheck the urine specific gravity in two weeks.

harm.zh-CN: 危险：RCH 2022要求可疑尿崩症的孩子随时能喝到水，任何时候都不限制饮水。婴儿不能自己找水喝，若确是加压素缺乏，在家限水可很快导致高钠性脱水和抽搐；如果还有未发现的ACTH缺乏，脱水和低血糖可叠加成肾上腺危象（BSPED 2023）。
harm.en: Dangerous: RCH 2022 keeps water freely available to a child with suspected DI and never restricts it. An infant cannot fetch his own water; if he has vasopressin deficiency, restriction at home can quickly cause hypernatraemic dehydration and seizures, and with an undetected ACTH deficiency dehydration and hypoglycaemia can add up to an adrenal crisis (BSPED 2023).

response.zh-CN: 已向家长提出。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Advice given to the parents. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 在普通病房做禁水试验
name.en: Water deprivation test on the general ward

dose.zh-CN: 标准8小时禁水试验：每2小时测尿比重和体重，结束时给去氨加压素，看尿液能否浓缩。
dose.en: A standard 8-hour water deprivation test: urine specific gravity and weight every 2 hours, then desmopressin at the end to see whether the urine concentrates.

harm.zh-CN: 不在这里做：RCH 2022指出禁水试验只应在专科指导下进行，出于安全考虑可能不适用于12个月以下婴儿。他的皮质醇和甲状腺轴还未查清，婴儿禁水同时也是禁食，有低血糖风险（PES 2015）。先做配对的血钠、血浆和尿渗透压，确需试验时由儿科内分泌团队在有条件的中心严密监测下进行。
harm.en: Not here: RCH 2022 reserves the deprivation test for specialist guidance and notes it may not be appropriate under 12 months for safety. His cortisol and thyroid axes are still unknown, and deprivation in an infant is also a fast, with a risk of hypoglycaemia (PES 2015). Paired sodium, plasma and urine osmolality come first; any test still needed is run by the paediatric endocrine team under close monitoring in a centre equipped for it.

response.zh-CN: 已安排。本病例不模拟禁水试验的过程和结果。
response.en: Arranged. The case does not simulate the test or its result.

title.en: Take the history from his parent

hint.zh-CN: 他自己说不了：眼睛的问题从什么时候开始、是什么样子？运动发育到了哪一步？吃喝、睡觉和小便有什么特别？出生前后有什么情况？
hint.en: He cannot tell you himself: when did the eye problem start and what is it like? How far has his movement come? Is anything unusual about his drinking, sleeping or urine? What happened around his birth?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁向陪同的家长了解病史。
guidance.en: Go to the cot side and take the history from his parent.

title.zh-CN: 床旁检查视觉、肌张力和全身
title.en: Check his sight, tone and body at the cot side

hint.zh-CN: 他的眼睛看得见东西吗——哪些床旁检查能回答这个问题？除了神经系统，还有哪个部位的查体可能和眼睛的问题有关联？
hint.en: Can his eyes see — and which bedside checks answer that? Beyond the nervous system, which other part of the examination might connect to the eye problem?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁检查视觉反应、瞳孔、肌张力、运动能力、听觉反应和外生殖器，并称体重。
guidance.en: At the cot side, check his visual responses, pupils, tone, motor skills, response to sound and genitalia, and weigh him.

title.zh-CN: 形成初步判断并开始评估
title.en: Form a working view and start the assessment

hint.zh-CN: 哪些发现用斜视解释不了？在影像结果出来之前，哪些可能致命的问题就应该开始查？
hint.en: Which findings can a squint not explain, and which possibly lethal problems should you start looking for before any scan is back?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策 1，在床旁开始相应的检查和护理，并请相关专科会诊。
guidance.en: Answer decision 1 on the case board, start the matching tests and care at the cot side, and call in the specialists you need.

hint.zh-CN: 眼底、诱发电位和磁共振合在一起说明了什么？尿比重低能说明什么，又不能说明什么？
hint.en: What do the fundi, the evoked potentials and the MRI say together — and what can, and cannot, a low urine specific gravity tell you?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅眼科、电生理、磁共振、尿液和血液报告，再到会诊板作答决策 2 和决策 3。
guidance.en: Read the eye, electrophysiology, MRI, urine and blood reports at the nurses' station, then answer decisions 2 and 3 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 解读内分泌与发育结果并制定计划
title.en: Interpret the endocrine and developmental results and plan ahead

hint.zh-CN: 这些激素结果哪些可以信赖、哪些需要核实？开始任何激素治疗之前，必须先弄清哪一条轴？出院后谁来接着照顾他？
hint.en: Which of these hormone results can you rely on, and which need checking? Which axis must be clear before any hormone is started — and who looks after him once he goes home?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅生长激素、甲状腺功能和发育评估报告，作答决策 4 和决策 5，并安排出院后的预案和转介。
guidance.en: Read the growth hormone, thyroid and developmental reports, answer decisions 4 and 5, and arrange the plan and referrals for after discharge.

title.zh-CN: 复盘报告记录的处理与复查
title.en: Review the reported management and the review visit

hint.zh-CN: 报告的处理和你的计划哪里一样、哪里不同？复查时的结果说明了什么，又有哪些仍不知道？
hint.en: Where does the report's management match your plan, and where does it differ? What do the review findings show — and what is still unknown?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅报告记录的诊断、处理与复查结果。
guidance.en: Read the report's diagnosis, management and review findings at the nurses' station.

prompt.zh-CN: 6月龄男婴，双眼间断上斜20余天；至今抬头不稳，不会翻身、独坐，也不会主动抓物；每天饮水约1200 mL，夜里尿多；出生后头3个月很少哭，吃奶后就睡，每天约睡22小时。查体：不能注视和追视，强光照射无瞬目反射；瞳孔左3 mm、右4 mm，直接和间接对光反射消失；四肢肌张力低；阴茎长约1 cm，双侧阴囊饱满，无隐睾。还没有任何检查结果。你的初步判断和首要安排是什么？
prompt.en: A 6-month-old boy has had intermittent upward deviation of both eyes for over 20 days; he still cannot hold his head steady, roll or sit unsupported, and does not grasp objects of his own accord; he drinks about 1200 mL a day and passes a lot of urine at night; in his first three months he hardly cried, slept after feeds and slept about 22 hours a day. On examination he does not fix or follow and does not blink to a bright light; the pupils are 3 mm on the left and 4 mm on the right with absent direct and consensual light reflexes; limb tone is reduced; the penis is about 1 cm long, the scrotum is full on both sides and no testis is undescended. No results are back yet. What is your working view, and what comes first?

need.zh-CN: 先向家长问清眼睛的问题、运动发育、饮水和小便、早期睡眠，并检查视觉反应、瞳孔、肌张力和外生殖器。
need.en: First ask his parent about the eyes, his motor development, his drinking and urine and his early sleep, and examine his visual responses, pupils, tone and genitalia.

text.zh-CN: 考虑双侧视神经发育异常并可能有下丘脑-垂体功能障碍：安排头颅磁共振、眼底和视觉诱发电位，同时马上开始垂体评估——皮质醇、甲状腺功能、血糖、血钠和配对渗透压——并记录出入量。
text.en: Suspect bilateral optic nerve maldevelopment with possible hypothalamic–pituitary dysfunction: brain MRI, fundoscopy and visual evoked potentials, and start the pituitary assessment now — cortisol, thyroid function, glucose, sodium with paired osmolalities — with an intake–output chart.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。不注视、不追视、强光不眨眼，加上直接和间接对光反射都消失，说明病变在前部视路（视神经），不是眼外肌或视皮质的问题；同时出现小阴茎、多饮多尿和早期嗜睡，提示同一个中线发育异常累及下丘脑-垂体。最先要查的是可能致命的激素缺乏，而且不必等影像结果：ACTH缺乏可在应激时引起肾上腺危象（BSPED 2023），低血糖则按PES 2015的阈值评估。
feedback.en: Right. No fixing or following, no blink to bright light and absent direct and consensual light reflexes put the lesion in the anterior visual pathway (the optic nerves), not the eye muscles or the visual cortex; a micropenis, heavy drinking with much urine at night and early sleepiness suggest the same midline maldevelopment reaches the hypothalamus and pituitary. The deficiencies that can kill come first and need no scan to start: ACTH deficiency can cause an adrenal crisis under stress (BSPED 2023), and hypoglycaemia is judged against the PES 2015 thresholds.

text.zh-CN: 按婴儿型斜视处理：转眼科验光并遮盖治疗，3个月后复查眼位；运动落后先按发育偏慢随访，喝水多看作习惯，暂不做抽血化验和头颅影像检查，等眼位稳定后再评估其他问题。
text.en: Treat it as infantile strabismus: refraction and patching through the eye clinic with a review of alignment in 3 months; follow the motor delay as slow development and the heavy drinking as habit, with no bloods or brain imaging until the alignment has settled.

feedback.zh-CN: 婴儿型斜视的孩子能注视、追视，瞳孔对光反射正常；他不能注视、强光不眨眼、对光反射消失，是看不见，而不是眼位不正。把小阴茎和多饮当作无关表现，会漏掉可能危及生命的垂体功能减退——未发现的ACTH缺乏可在一次感染时发展为肾上腺危象（BSPED 2023）。
feedback.en: An infant with strabismus fixes, follows and has normal pupil reflexes; this baby does not fix, does not blink to light and has no light reflexes — he cannot see, rather than having misaligned eyes. Treating the micropenis and heavy drinking as unrelated risks missing hypopituitarism, and undetected ACTH deficiency can turn one infection into an adrenal crisis (BSPED 2023).

text.zh-CN: 首先按癫痫发作处理，眼球上翻看作强直发作：先静脉给抗癫痫药负荷量控制发作，再做脑电图和头颅磁共振；视觉反应差和肌张力低暂时归于发作后状态，内分泌评估等发作完全控制住以后再做。
text.en: Treat it first as epileptic seizures, the upward deviation being tonic seizures: load an IV antiseizure drug, then arrange an EEG and a brain MRI; put the poor visual responses and low tone down to a post-ictal state and leave the endocrine assessment until the seizures are under control.

feedback.zh-CN: 间断眼球上翻确实要想到发作，脑电图也合理；但发作后状态解释不了持续的不注视和对光反射消失，更解释不了小阴茎和多饮。没有发作证据就静脉负荷抗癫痫药并推迟内分泌评估，会让低血糖（PES 2015）和肾上腺皮质功能不全（BSPED 2023）继续无人评估。
feedback.en: Intermittent upward deviation does raise seizures, and an EEG is reasonable; but a post-ictal state cannot explain persistently absent fixation and light reflexes, let alone the micropenis and heavy drinking. Loading an antiseizure drug without evidence of seizures while deferring the endocrine work-up leaves hypoglycaemia (PES 2015) and adrenal insufficiency (BSPED 2023) unassessed.

text.zh-CN: 考虑过期产、羊水缺乏引起的围产期缺氧缺血性脑损伤伴皮质盲：安排头颅磁共振和康复训练；瞳孔改变和多饮都可以用脑损伤解释，暂不需要垂体功能检查，等影像结果出来再说。
text.en: Suspect perinatal hypoxic–ischaemic brain injury with cortical visual impairment after a post-term birth without amniotic fluid: brain MRI and rehabilitation; brain injury explains the pupils and the drinking, so pituitary tests can wait until the scan is back.

feedback.zh-CN: 过期妊娠和羊水缺乏确是围产期危险因素，但皮质盲的婴儿瞳孔对光反射保留，而他直接和间接对光反射都消失，病变在视神经。缺氧性脑损伤也解释不了小阴茎；垂体功能要直接检查，不必等影像：未发现的ACTH缺乏可使他下一次生病时发生肾上腺危象（BSPED 2023）。
feedback.en: A post-term pregnancy without amniotic fluid is a perinatal risk, but cortical visual impairment spares the pupil reflexes, whereas he has lost both the direct and consensual responses — the lesion is in the optic nerves. Hypoxic injury does not explain the micropenis either, and the pituitary needs testing in its own right without waiting for a scan: an unrecognised ACTH deficiency can turn his next illness into an adrenal crisis (BSPED 2023).

prompt.zh-CN: 眼底：双侧视神经萎缩。视觉诱发电位潜伏期延长、振幅下降；听觉诱发电位未见异常。头颅磁共振：透明隔缺如，侧脑室和第三脑室扩大、额角呈方形，视神经和视交叉纤细（磁共振记录中没有关于垂体的描述）。怎样解读，对垂体意味着什么？
prompt.en: Fundoscopy: bilateral optic atrophy. Visual evoked potentials: prolonged latency and reduced amplitude; auditory evoked potentials: no abnormality. Brain MRI: absent septum pellucidum, enlarged lateral and third ventricles with squared frontal horns, and thin optic nerves and chiasm (no description of the pituitary is recorded). How do you read this, and what does it mean for the pituitary?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 1，并调阅眼底、视觉和听觉诱发电位以及头颅磁共振报告。
need.en: Answer decision 1 and read the fundoscopy, both evoked potential reports and the brain MRI first.

text.zh-CN: 符合视隔发育不良（视神经、视交叉细小合并透明隔缺如）：不论影像上垂体如何，都要评估全部垂体轴，并在整个儿童期定期复查，因为激素缺乏可以以后才出现。
text.en: This fits septo-optic dysplasia — thin optic nerves and chiasm with an absent septum pellucidum: assess every pituitary axis whatever the pituitary looks like on imaging, and repeat it through childhood, as deficiencies can appear later.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。视神经和视交叉细小加上透明隔缺如，就是视隔发育不良；方形额角是透明隔缺如时额角的典型形态。垂体激素缺乏在这类患儿中常见，而且可以逐渐出现，所以要全面评估并定期复查；其中ACTH缺乏最危险，一旦证实就按BSPED 2023准备应急氢化可的松。PES 2016也把下丘脑-垂体结构缺陷作为生长激素缺乏的证据之一。
feedback.en: Right. Thin optic nerves and chiasm with an absent septum pellucidum are septo-optic dysplasia; squared frontal horns are the typical shape of the frontal horns when the septum is missing. Pituitary deficiencies are common in this condition and can appear over time, so every axis is assessed and re-assessed; ACTH deficiency is the dangerous one, and once confirmed it calls for the BSPED 2023 emergency hydrocortisone plan. PES 2016 likewise counts hypothalamic–pituitary malformations among the evidence for GH deficiency.

text.zh-CN: 透明隔缺如是常见的正常变异，视神经细小是视神经萎缩继发的改变，两者合在一起不构成综合征：只需眼科定期随访视力和眼位，不必评估垂体功能，也不必复查磁共振。
text.en: An absent septum pellucidum is a common normal variant and the thin nerves simply follow from the optic atrophy, so together they make no syndrome: follow his vision and alignment in the eye clinic, with no pituitary assessment and no repeat MRI.

feedback.zh-CN: 常见的正常变异是透明隔腔，而不是透明隔缺如；透明隔缺如合并视神经和视交叉细小，正符合视隔发育不良的定义。他已有小阴茎和多饮多尿，只做眼科随访会漏掉垂体功能减退，而ACTH缺乏在应激时可以致命（BSPED 2023）。
feedback.en: The common normal variant is a cavum septi pellucidi, not an absent septum; an absent septum with thin optic nerves and chiasm is what defines septo-optic dysplasia. With a micropenis, heavy drinking and much urine at night already present, eye-clinic follow-up alone would miss hypopituitarism, and ACTH deficiency can be fatal under stress (BSPED 2023).

text.zh-CN: 侧脑室和第三脑室扩大说明是梗阻性脑积水，视神经萎缩是颅内压增高造成的：先请神经外科评估分流手术，内分泌问题等分流做完再处理。
text.en: The enlarged lateral and third ventricles mean obstructive hydrocephalus and the optic atrophy comes from raised pressure: neurosurgical review for a shunt first, and the endocrine questions once the shunt is in.

feedback.zh-CN: 脑室扩大要结合头围、前囟和颅内压增高的表现判断，这些本病例都没有记录；而视神经和视交叉细小、透明隔缺如是发育畸形，不是受压的结果。出现颅压增高迹象当然要请神经外科，但内分泌评估不能等：皮质醇情况不明的婴儿在麻醉和手术应激下有肾上腺危象的风险，BSPED 2023正是为此给肾上腺皮质功能不全的孩子设定围手术期氢化可的松方案。
feedback.en: Ventricular size has to be read with the head circumference, the fontanelle and signs of raised pressure, none of which this case records — and thin optic nerves and chiasm with an absent septum are a malformation, not the result of pressure. Signs of raised pressure would need neurosurgery, but the endocrine work-up cannot wait: an infant whose cortisol is unknown is at risk of an adrenal crisis under anaesthesia and surgery, which is why BSPED 2023 sets peri-operative hydrocortisone cover for children with adrenal insufficiency.

text.zh-CN: 符合视隔发育不良，但只需查生长激素轴：生长激素缺乏在这类患儿中最常见，肾上腺轴和甲状腺轴出问题时会有明显症状，到那时再查也来得及，可以免去不必要的抽血。
text.en: This is septo-optic dysplasia, but only the GH axis needs testing: GH deficiency is the commonest deficiency here, and adrenal or thyroid problems would show themselves clearly in time to test them then, sparing him needless blood tests.

feedback.zh-CN: 诊断对了，评估范围错了。生长激素缺乏确实最常见，但婴儿的ACTH缺乏可以只表现为嗜睡、喂养差或低血糖，直到一次感染诱发肾上腺危象（BSPED 2023）；中枢性甲减时TSH可以正常，要看FT4。各轴都要查，并且要复查。
feedback.en: Right diagnosis, wrong scope. GH deficiency is indeed the commonest, but ACTH deficiency in an infant may show only as sleepiness, poor feeding or hypoglycaemia until an infection tips him into an adrenal crisis (BSPED 2023), and in central hypothyroidism the TSH can be normal, so the free T4 is what counts. Every axis is tested, and re-tested.

prompt.zh-CN: 多次尿比重1.002–1.006；血电解质和肾功能报告正常（包括血钠在内的具体数值没有记录）；血糖5.12 mmol/L。家长说他每天饮水约1200 mL，夜里尿多。因年龄小，未完成禁水试验。对可能的中枢性尿崩症（精氨酸加压素缺乏症），下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: Urine specific gravity is 1.002–1.006 on repeated testing; electrolytes and renal function are reported as normal (no individual values, sodium included, are recorded); blood glucose is 5.12 mmol/L. His parent says he drinks about 1200 mL a day and passes a lot of urine at night. A water deprivation test was not completed because of his young age. What is the next step on the question of central diabetes insipidus (arginine vasopressin deficiency)?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅尿比重、电解质和肾功能、血糖报告，并向家长问清饮水和小便情况。
need.en: Read the urine specific gravity, electrolytes and renal function and glucose reports, and ask his parent about his drinking and urine first.

text.zh-CN: 随时饮水并记录出入量；同时查血钠、血浆渗透压和配对的尿渗透压，并查清皮质醇和甲状腺轴；仍不明确时，由儿科内分泌团队决定是否在严密监测下做禁水试验。
text.en: Offer him water freely and often and chart intake and output; send a sodium and plasma osmolality with a paired urine osmolality and clarify the cortisol and thyroid axes; if still unclear, paediatric endocrinology decides on a closely monitored deprivation test.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。RCH 2022尿崩症指南要求可疑尿崩症的孩子随时能喝到水、不限制饮水，禁水试验只在专科指导下进行，并指出出于安全考虑可能不适用于12个月以下婴儿。同时采的血、尿渗透压和血钠常能直接回答问题，不必让婴儿禁水；皮质醇缺乏会掩盖多尿（补充氢化可的松后才显现），甲减也影响水的排泄，所以这两条轴要一并查清。2022年多学会立场声明建议把中枢性尿崩症改称精氨酸加压素缺乏症。
feedback.en: Right. The RCH 2022 diabetes insipidus guideline keeps water freely available to a child with suspected DI, never restricts it, reserves the deprivation test for specialist guidance and notes it may not be appropriate under 12 months for safety. Blood and urine osmolality and sodium taken together often answer the question without depriving an infant; cortisol deficiency can mask polyuria (it may appear once hydrocortisone starts) and hypothyroidism also impairs water excretion, so both axes are clarified alongside. The 2022 multi-society position statement renames central DI arginine vasopressin deficiency.

text.zh-CN: 尿比重这么低、喝得这么多，已足以诊断中枢性尿崩症：现在就开始口服去氨加压素，按夜里尿量减少的情况逐步加量，不必再测渗透压，也不必等皮质醇和甲状腺的结果出来。
text.en: Urine this dilute with this much drinking is enough to diagnose central diabetes insipidus: start oral desmopressin now and increase it until the night-time urine falls, without osmolality tests and without waiting for the cortisol and thyroid results to come back.

feedback.zh-CN: 低比重尿加大量饮水，也可以只是喝得多——饮水多本身就会让尿液稀释。没有证实加压素缺乏就用去氨加压素，而他仍照常大量饮水，可迅速出现稀释性低钠血症和抽搐；RCH 2022要求先在专科指导下明确诊断。去氨加压素应在确诊后由儿科内分泌医生小剂量起用，并监测血钠。
feedback.en: Dilute urine with heavy drinking can also be plain heavy drinking, since drinking a lot dilutes the urine by itself. Desmopressin without proven vasopressin deficiency, while he goes on drinking heavily, can quickly cause dilutional hyponatraemia and seizures; RCH 2022 asks for the diagnosis to be made under specialist guidance first. Desmopressin is started after confirmation, by paediatric endocrinology, at a low dose with sodium monitoring.

text.zh-CN: 请家长在家把他每天的饮水量减到同龄婴儿的正常范围，两周后复查尿比重；如果尿比重升高，就说明只是喝水的习惯问题，可以避免住院做更多检查。
text.en: Ask his parents to cut his daily water to the normal range for his age at home and recheck the urine specific gravity in two weeks; a rise would show it was only a drinking habit and spare him more tests in hospital.

feedback.zh-CN: 危险。RCH 2022明确要求可疑尿崩症的孩子随时能喝到水，任何时候都不限制饮水：婴儿不能自己找水喝，若确是加压素缺乏，在家限水可很快导致高钠性脱水和抽搐。如果还有未发现的ACTH缺乏，脱水和低血糖会叠加成肾上腺危象（BSPED 2023）。
feedback.en: Dangerous. RCH 2022 keeps water freely available to a child with suspected DI and never restricts it: an infant cannot fetch his own water, and if he does have vasopressin deficiency, restriction at home can quickly cause hypernatraemic dehydration and seizures. With an undetected ACTH deficiency, dehydration and hypoglycaemia can add up to an adrenal crisis (BSPED 2023).

text.zh-CN: 血电解质和肾功能都正常，说明他能维持水平衡，可以排除尿崩症；多饮多尿按习惯处理，不需要再评估，出院后让家长观察就行。
text.en: Normal electrolytes and renal function show he keeps his water balance, so diabetes insipidus is excluded; treat the drinking as habit, with no further assessment beyond the parents watching at home.

feedback.zh-CN: 能自由喝水时，加压素缺乏的孩子靠多喝水把血钠维持在正常范围，所以血钠正常排除不了尿崩症，何况这里连具体数值都没有记录。要回答这个问题，需要同时采的血钠、血浆和尿渗透压，必要时由专科决定进一步检查（RCH 2022）。
feedback.en: With free access to water, a child with vasopressin deficiency keeps the sodium normal by drinking more, so a normal sodium does not exclude DI — and here not even the value is recorded. The question needs a paired sodium, plasma and urine osmolality, with further testing decided by specialists if needed (RCH 2022).

text.zh-CN: 在普通病房做一次标准的8小时禁水试验：每2小时测尿比重、血钠和体重，试验结束时给去氨加压素，看尿液能否浓缩，这样一次就能把诊断定下来，不用再反复抽血。
text.en: Run a standard 8-hour water deprivation test on the general ward, with urine specific gravity, sodium and weight every 2 hours and desmopressin at the end to see whether the urine concentrates, settling the diagnosis in one go without repeated blood tests.

feedback.zh-CN: 思路对，地点和对象不对。RCH 2022指出禁水试验只应在专科指导下进行，出于安全考虑可能不适用于12个月以下婴儿；他的皮质醇和甲状腺轴还未查清，婴儿禁水同时也是禁食，有低血糖风险（PES 2015）。先做配对的血、尿渗透压，确需试验时由儿科内分泌团队在有条件的中心严密监测下进行。
feedback.en: Right idea, wrong place and patient. RCH 2022 reserves the deprivation test for specialist guidance and notes it may not be appropriate under 12 months for safety; his cortisol and thyroid axes are still unknown, and deprivation in an infant is also a fast, with a risk of hypoglycaemia (PES 2015). Paired blood and urine osmolality come first, and any test still needed is run by the paediatric endocrine team under close monitoring in a centre equipped for it.

prompt.zh-CN: 首次生长激素激发试验0.10、0.05、0.09、0.18 nmol/L，报告据此判断为生长激素缺乏；此后另一项生长激素结果印为10.06 nmol/L，与报告的判断不一致（时间和条件没有记录）。甲状腺功能报告正常（数值没有记录）；本病例没有皮质醇结果。你的生长激素方案是什么？
prompt.en: His first GH stimulation test gave 0.10, 0.05, 0.09 and 0.18 nmol/L, which the report read as GH deficiency; a later GH result is printed as 10.06 nmol/L, which does not fit that reading (its timing and conditions are not recorded). Thyroid function is reported as normal (no values recorded); this case has no cortisol result. What is your GH plan?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅生长激素检测报告和甲状腺功能。
need.en: Read the growth hormone report and the thyroid function first.

text.zh-CN: 核对后一项生长激素值的原始化验单并查皮质醇；缺乏的判断成立、肾上腺轴明确（缺乏者先替代）后，由儿科内分泌医生开始生长激素治疗，用药后复查FT4和皮质醇。
text.en: Check the later GH value's original report and test cortisol; if the deficiency stands, paediatric endocrinology starts GH once the adrenal axis is clear (replaced first if deficient) and rechecks free T4 and cortisol.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。PES 2016为使成年身高正常、避免极度矮小而强烈推荐用生长激素治疗生长激素缺乏，同时强烈建议不要把激发试验结果作为唯一的诊断依据——前后矛盾的数值要回到原始报告核实，不能自行“修正”。生长激素会加快皮质醇代谢、促进T4转化为T3，可使潜在的肾上腺皮质功能不全或中枢性甲减显现，所以开始前先查清肾上腺轴；PES 2016还强烈推荐在开始后重新评估肾上腺轴和甲状腺轴。
feedback.en: Right. PES 2016 strongly recommends GH for GH deficiency to normalise adult height and avoid extreme shortness, and strongly advises against relying on stimulation tests as the sole diagnostic criterion — a contradictory value goes back to the original report, never 'corrected' by hand. GH speeds cortisol metabolism and T4-to-T3 conversion and can unmask latent adrenal insufficiency or central hypothyroidism, so the adrenal axis is clarified before starting, and PES 2016 strongly recommends re-assessing the adrenal and thyroid axes once GH has started.

text.zh-CN: 暂不用生长激素：只要身长还在正常范围，就每3个月测一次身长和甲状腺功能，等出现生长减速再开始治疗，这样既免去可能不必要的每日注射，也能减轻家庭的经济负担。
text.en: Hold off GH: while his length stays in the normal range, measure length and thyroid function every 3 months and start only when growth slows, which spares him daily injections he may not need and eases the family's costs.

feedback.zh-CN: 这接近报告当年的做法。PES 2016为使成年身高正常、避免极度矮小而强烈推荐治疗生长激素缺乏；一次身长正常不是不治疗的理由，等到生长减速才开始已损失了生长。经济困难是真实的障碍，应作为需要解决的问题（社会支持、医保或援助项目），而不是改变治疗指征的理由。
feedback.en: This is close to what the report did. PES 2016 strongly recommends treating GH deficiency to normalise adult height and avoid extreme shortness; a length in the normal range today is no reason to withhold it, and waiting for growth to slow gives growth away. Cost is a real barrier, to be solved through social work, insurance or assistance schemes, not a reason to change the indication.

text.zh-CN: 把10.06看作0.06的印刷错误，这样所有生长激素值都很低，缺乏就已确定：本周就开始每日生长激素，皮质醇等他用上药、情况稳定后再查，免得再拖延治疗。
text.en: Read 10.06 as a misprint for 0.06, so every GH value is low and the deficiency is settled: start daily GH this week and test cortisol once he is settled on it, rather than delaying treatment for more blood tests.

feedback.zh-CN: 两处都有风险。把数值改成预期的样子是未经证实的修正，必须核对原始化验单；而在皮质醇轴未明时先开始生长激素，可能使潜在的肾上腺皮质功能不全显现，诱发BSPED 2023所述的肾上腺危象。PES 2016也提醒不能只凭激发试验的数值下诊断。
feedback.en: Two risks at once. Changing a value to the one you expected is an unverified correction — the original laboratory report must be checked; and starting GH before the cortisol axis is known can unmask latent adrenal insufficiency and precipitate the adrenal crisis BSPED 2023 describes. PES 2016 also warns against diagnosing on stimulation values alone.

text.zh-CN: 后一项10.06 nmol/L说明生长激素分泌已经恢复，首次激发试验大概是婴儿期常见的假阳性：不需要替代治疗，也不必继续内分泌随访，按常规儿童保健随访即可。
text.en: The later 10.06 nmol/L shows that GH secretion has recovered and that the first test was probably an infancy false positive: no replacement and no further endocrine follow-up are needed beyond routine child health checks.

feedback.zh-CN: 一个时间不明、单位可疑的数值推翻不了报告的判断，更不能作为停止随访的理由：时间、方法和单位都要先核实。视隔发育不良的垂体功能会随时间变化，新的激素缺乏可以陆续出现；PES 2016也要求生长激素缺乏的评估和治疗由儿科内分泌医生负责。
feedback.en: One value of unknown timing and doubtful unit cannot overturn the report's reading, still less end follow-up: its timing, method and unit are checked first. In septo-optic dysplasia pituitary function changes over time, with new deficiencies able to appear, and PES 2016 places the evaluation and treatment of GH deficiency with paediatric endocrinologists.

text.zh-CN: 垂体激素缺乏往往成组出现：生长激素和左甲状腺素同时开始，因为甲状腺功能虽然报告正常，也可能是早期的中枢性甲减，提前补充可以保护他的大脑发育。
text.en: Pituitary deficiencies tend to cluster: start GH and levothyroxine together, since thyroid function reported as normal may still be early central hypothyroidism, and treating it early protects his developing brain.

feedback.zh-CN: 左甲状腺素要有测得的低FT4才用；在皮质醇轴未明时补甲状腺素会加快皮质醇清除，可能诱发肾上腺危象——BSPED 2023所述的急症。中枢性甲减确实可以以后才出现，所以要定期复查FT4，而不是预先用药。
feedback.en: Levothyroxine needs a measured low free T4; given while the cortisol axis is unknown it speeds cortisol clearance and can precipitate an adrenal crisis, the emergency BSPED 2023 sets out. Central hypothyroidism can indeed appear later, which is why the free T4 is rechecked regularly rather than treated in advance.

prompt.zh-CN: Gesell发育评估：发育商35。他完成住院评估后要出院，需要长期随访。随访计划应包括什么？
prompt.en: Gesell assessment: developmental quotient 35. Once his inpatient assessment is complete he will go home and need long-term follow-up. What should the follow-up plan include?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 4，并调阅Gesell发育评估。
need.en: Answer decision 4 and read the Gesell assessment first.

text.zh-CN: 定期复查生长速度和各垂体轴（皮质醇、FT4、血钠和水、血糖）直到青春期；证实ACTH缺乏者给应急卡、肌注氢化可的松并教会应激加量；转介早期干预和视觉康复。
text.en: Review growth velocity and every pituitary axis (cortisol, free T4, sodium and water, glucose) into puberty; if ACTH deficiency is confirmed, an emergency card, IM hydrocortisone and sick-day teaching; early intervention and vision habilitation.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。垂体功能会随时间变化，各轴都要定期复查；一旦证实ACTH缺乏，BSPED 2023要求随身应急卡、应激加量（中重度疾病约30 mg/m²/日，分4次）和1岁以下婴儿肌注氢化可的松25 mg的急救方案。发育商35说明发育明显落后，视力严重受损的婴儿需要尽早开始针对视觉障碍的早期干预。
feedback.en: Right. Pituitary function changes over time, so every axis is re-checked; once ACTH deficiency is confirmed, BSPED 2023 sets an emergency card, sick-day doses (about 30 mg/m²/day in four doses for moderate to severe illness) and IM hydrocortisone 25 mg for an infant under one year. A developmental quotient of 35 means marked delay, and an infant with severe visual impairment needs early intervention built around his sight.

text.zh-CN: 主要问题在眼睛：转眼科定期随访视力和眼位，等视力好转后再开始康复训练，免得看不见时训练事倍功半；内分泌一年复查一次，结合每次儿童保健体检时测的身长和体重就够了。
text.en: The main problem is his eyes: eye-clinic follow-up of vision and alignment, with developmental therapy only once his sight improves so the effort is not wasted, and a yearly endocrine check alongside the length and weight measured at his routine child health visits.

feedback.zh-CN: 视神经发育异常造成的视力损害不会等来“好转后再训练”的时机，早期干预要从现在开始。一年一次的内分泌复查跟不上婴儿期可能新出现的激素缺乏；一旦出现ACTH缺乏，家长还需要BSPED 2023的应急方案。
feedback.en: Visual loss from optic nerve maldevelopment does not wait for a better moment to start therapy — early intervention begins now. A yearly endocrine check is too slow for deficiencies that can emerge in infancy, and if ACTH deficiency appears the family will need the BSPED 2023 emergency plan.

text.zh-CN: 如果出院前皮质醇和甲状腺功能都正常，就可以结束内分泌随访，以后由社区按常规体检、测身长体重，有症状再回医院，这样也能减少家庭来回奔波和费用。
text.en: If cortisol and thyroid function are normal before discharge, endocrine follow-up can end: routine community checks of length and weight take over, with a return only for symptoms, which also spares the family travel and cost.

feedback.zh-CN: 一次正常的结果只代表当下：这类患儿的垂体激素缺乏可以在以后数月或数年才出现，所以要定期复查，生长速度也要持续监测（PES 2016把生长激素缺乏的评估交给儿科内分泌医生）。家长还需要知道哪些表现提示肾上腺危象或低血糖（BSPED 2023；PES 2015）。
feedback.en: One normal result speaks only for now: in this condition pituitary deficiencies can appear months or years later, so testing is repeated and growth velocity watched (PES 2016 places GH evaluation with paediatric endocrinologists). The parents also need to know the signs of an adrenal crisis or hypoglycaemia (BSPED 2023; PES 2015).

text.zh-CN: 所有视隔发育不良的婴儿都长期口服小剂量氢化可的松预防，不必等检查结果，这样就不会发生肾上腺危象，家长也不用再学习应激加量和应急肌内注射的方法。
text.en: Give every infant with septo-optic dysplasia long-term low-dose oral hydrocortisone as prevention, without waiting for test results, so that no adrenal crisis can happen and the parents need not learn sick-day doses or the emergency injection.

feedback.zh-CN: 没有证实缺乏就长期用糖皮质激素，会抑制生长和下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴，还会让皮质醇检查无法解读。替代治疗、应激加量和应急肌注的方案（BSPED 2023）是给已证实肾上腺皮质功能不全的孩子的；检查期间若病情急转直下，应急使用氢化可的松不必等结果。
feedback.en: Long-term glucocorticoid without a proven deficiency suppresses growth and the hypothalamic–pituitary–adrenal axis and makes the cortisol tests uninterpretable. Replacement, sick-day doses and the emergency injection (BSPED 2023) are for a child with confirmed adrenal insufficiency — though if he becomes acutely unwell while the tests are pending, emergency hydrocortisone does not wait for results.

text.zh-CN: 向家长问清眼睛上斜的起病和表现、运动发育、饮水与夜尿、早期睡眠，以及孕期、分娩方式和原因、出生体重和父母是否近亲
text.en: Took from the parent the onset and pattern of the eye deviation, motor development, drinking and night-time urine, early sleep, and the pregnancy, the mode of and reason for delivery, birth weight and parental consanguinity

text.zh-CN: 检查注视、追视和瞬目反应，瞳孔与对光反射，肌张力，竖头、翻身和独坐，以及外生殖器
text.en: Examined fixing, following and blink, the pupils and light reflexes, tone, head control, rolling and sitting, and the genitalia

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把视觉、运动和内分泌线索归为同一个中线发育问题，并先查可能致命的激素缺乏（决策 1）
text.en: Linked the visual, motor and endocrine clues to one midline disorder and put the possibly lethal deficiencies first, at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 在内分泌评估报告开放之前（入院阶段或眼科影像报告阶段）就送检皮质醇，筛查肾上腺轴
text.en: Sent a cortisol to screen the adrenal axis before the endocrine reports opened (in the admission or the eye-and-imaging-report phase)

text.zh-CN: 调阅眼底、视觉诱发电位、头颅磁共振、尿比重、电解质与肾功能和血糖报告，以及生长激素、甲状腺功能和发育评估
text.en: Read the fundoscopy, VEP, brain MRI, urine specific gravity, electrolytes and renal function and glucose reports, and the GH, thyroid and developmental assessments

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把影像和眼科结果解读为视隔发育不良，并要求评估和复查全部垂体轴（决策 2）
text.en: Read the imaging and eye reports as septo-optic dysplasia needing every pituitary axis assessed and re-assessed, at the first attempt (decision 2)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择随时饮水加配对血、尿渗透压的安全评估路径（决策 3）
text.en: Chose free water with paired blood and urine osmolality as the safe route to the diagnosis, at the first attempt (decision 3)

text.zh-CN: 没有让家长在家限水，没有在普通病房做禁水试验，也没有在未确诊时用去氨加压素
text.en: Did not restrict his water at home, run a deprivation test on the general ward or give desmopressin without a diagnosis

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即在核实矛盾数值、查清肾上腺轴之后再开始生长激素，并计划用药后复查（决策 4）
text.en: Planned GH only after checking the contradictory value and the adrenal axis, with rechecks once started, at the first attempt (decision 4)

text.zh-CN: 肾上腺轴未明、后一项生长激素值未核实时，没有开始左甲状腺素或生长激素
text.en: Started neither levothyroxine nor growth hormone while the adrenal axis was unknown and the later GH value unverified

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制定长期垂体复查、应急预案和早期干预的随访计划（决策 5）
text.en: Set long-term pituitary surveillance, an emergency plan and early intervention, at the first attempt (decision 5)

text.zh-CN: 完成关键处置：随时饮水并记录出入量、喂奶前测血糖、儿科内分泌会诊、肾上腺危象预案，以及视觉康复和早期干预转介
text.en: Carried out the keyed care: free water with an intake–output chart, pre-feed glucose checks, a paediatric endocrine consultation, an adrenal-crisis plan, and referrals for vision habilitation and early intervention

text.zh-CN: 向家长解释孩子的视力、发育和激素问题以及仍不确定的部分，交代危险信号并核实理解
text.en: Explained his sight, development and hormone problems and what is still uncertain to the parent, gave the danger signs and checked understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge结构，坏消息按SPIKES告知（安静的房间，请家长坐下；先问家长已经知道什么、最担心什么——看不看得见、能不能跟上同龄孩子——以及想了解多少；说坏消息前先给预告；先回应家长的情绪再往下谈）；用通俗的话说明眼睛往上斜不是普通斜视，而是视神经发育不好、孩子能看到的很有限，磁共振显示大脑中线结构发育异常，可能影响管激素的垂体；讲清有些激素缺乏（皮质醇）在生病时可能危及生命，所以要尽快查，并交代需要立即就医的表现（呕吐、精神差、吃奶差、发软、体温低）；强调任何时候都不要限制他喝水；说明有一项生长激素结果前后不一致，需要核对原始化验单后再定治疗；发育落后需要尽早开始康复和视觉训练；坦诚说明不确定性和长期随访的必要，不作“以后会看得见”或“会赶上来”的保证；如果费用是顾虑，说明可以寻求的支持；最后请家长用自己的话复述要点（回授法）。
judgeGuidance.en: Calgary–Cambridge structure, with SPIKES for the bad news (a quiet room, the parent seated; ask what they already know and fear most — whether he can see, whether he will catch up — and how much they want to hear; a warning shot before the news; respond to their emotion before moving on); explain in plain words that the upward eyes are not an ordinary squint but under-developed optic nerves, so he sees very little, and that the MRI shows a midline brain malformation that can affect the hormone-controlling pituitary; say that some hormone deficiencies (cortisol) can be life-threatening during illness, which is why they are checked quickly, and give the signs that need urgent care (vomiting, unusual sleepiness, poor feeding, floppiness, a low temperature); stress that his water must never be restricted; explain that one growth hormone result does not fit and must be checked against the original laboratory report before treatment is decided; say that therapy for his development and sight should start early; be honest about the uncertainty and the need for long-term follow-up, promising neither sight nor catching up; if cost is a worry, explain where support can be sought; finish with teach-back in the parent's own words.

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，按PEARLS引导，只围绕学员已经获得的资料提问。要引导出的推理：为什么不注视、强光不眨眼且对光反射消失的“斜视”其实是看不见，瞳孔反射怎样区分视神经病变和皮质盲；小阴茎、多饮夜尿和早期嗜睡为什么把眼睛和垂体联系在一起；哪些激素缺乏可能致命、应该最先查（皮质醇、血糖、血钠），为什么生长激素可以按部就班而皮质醇不能等；为什么任何时候都不能限水，婴儿的尿崩症怎样安全评估（RCH 2022），皮质醇缺乏为什么会掩盖多尿；与报告判断矛盾的数值为什么要核实而不是修改；生长激素为什么会让潜在的肾上腺和甲状腺功能减退显现；在PES 2016为使成年身高正常而强烈推荐治疗生长激素缺乏的前提下，为什么身长暂时在范围内本身不是不治疗的理由；随访计划为什么要包括定期复查、应急预案（BSPED 2023）和早期干预。历史与现行：复盘时再把报告因身高范围和家庭经济原因未用生长激素、尿崩症未能证实的经过，与PES 2016、RCH 2022对照。病例没有记录的内容（生命体征、入院身长和头围、血钠数值、渗透压、皮质醇、FT4和TSH数值、性激素、激发试验的药物和时间点、脑电图、磁共振上的垂体情况）不要替它补上。学员作答前不说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或报告的处理与结局。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher using PEARLS who asks only about information the learner already has. Reasoning to draw out: why a 'squint' with no fixing, no blink to light and absent light reflexes means he cannot see, and how the pupil reflexes separate optic nerve disease from cortical visual impairment; why a micropenis, heavy drinking with much urine at night and early sleepiness tie the eyes to the pituitary; which deficiencies can kill and come first (cortisol, glucose, sodium), and why GH can be worked up in order while cortisol cannot wait; why water is never restricted, how DI is assessed safely in an infant (RCH 2022) and why cortisol deficiency can mask polyuria; why a value that contradicts the report's reading is verified rather than edited; why GH can unmask latent adrenal and thyroid deficiency; why, with PES 2016's strong recommendation to treat GH deficiency to normalise adult height, a length still in range is not by itself a reason to withhold GH; why follow-up needs repeat testing, an emergency plan (BSPED 2023) and early intervention. Then and now: in the debrief, compare the report's decision to give no GH (height range, family finances) and its unconfirmed DI with PES 2016 and RCH 2022. Never supply what the case does not record (vital signs, admission length and head circumference, the sodium value, osmolalities, cortisol, free T4 and TSH values, sex hormones, the stimulation agents and time points, an EEG, the pituitary on MRI). Before the learner commits, never state the diagnosis, any decision's correct option, or the report's management and outcome.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：6月龄男婴，由家长陪同入院；双眼间断上斜20余天；至今抬头不稳，不会翻身，也不能独坐。病区有床旁血糖仪、称尿布用的秤和出入量记录单；血标本在床旁采集后送检验科；治疗车上有静脉置管用物，药品在药柜；病历和检查报告在护士站电脑上调阅。复述医嘱，只报告已经回报的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到病例没有记录的内容（体温、心率、呼吸、血压、入院身长、头围、血钠数值、皮质醇结果），如实说没有记录。除非内分泌团队安排有监护的试验，不限制他喝水；他自己拿不到水、也不会要水，所以要主动给他喂水。
knowledge.en: Paediatric ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): 6-month-old boy admitted with a parent; intermittent upward deviation of both eyes for over 20 days; still unable to hold his head steady, roll over or sit unsupported. The ward has a bedside glucose meter, nappy scales and intake–output charts; blood is taken at the bedside and sent to the laboratory; cannulation kit is on the treatment trolley and drugs are in the cupboard; notes and reports are on the nurses' station computer. Reads orders back and reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses; asked about anything the case does not record (temperature, heart rate, breathing rate, blood pressure, admission length, head circumference, the sodium value, a cortisol result), says plainly that it is not recorded. His water is never restricted unless the endocrine team plans a supervised test; he cannot reach for a drink or ask for one, so water is offered to him.

knowledge.zh-CN: 放射科医生，只在学员调阅头颅磁共振报告后解读它。可以讲：透明隔缺如合并视神经和视交叉细小，是视隔发育不良的影像表现；透明隔缺如时额角呈方形；单凭脑室扩大不能诊断脑积水，需要结合头围、前囟和颅内压增高的表现；完整的报告还应描述垂体前叶大小、垂体柄、垂体后叶高信号及其位置、胼胝体和皮质发育（如脑裂畸形），而这些在本病例的磁共振记录里都没有。不评论内分泌结果，不透露报告的处理和结局。
knowledge.en: Radiologist who interprets the brain MRI report only once the learner has read it. Can explain: an absent septum pellucidum with thin optic nerves and chiasm is the imaging pattern of septo-optic dysplasia; the frontal horns look squared when the septum is absent; ventricular size alone does not establish hydrocephalus — the head circumference, the fontanelle and signs of raised pressure are needed; a full report would also describe the size of the anterior pituitary, the stalk, the posterior pituitary bright spot and its position, the corpus callosum and cortical development such as schizencephaly, none of which this case's MRI record gives. Does not comment on the endocrine results or reveal the report's management and outcome.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童内分泌医生，只解读学员已经调阅的资料（尿比重、电解质与肾功能、血糖、生长激素和甲状腺功能）。可以讲：RCH 2022尿崩症指南——随时饮水、不限水，禁水试验只在专科指导下进行，出于安全可能不适用于12个月以下婴儿，配对的血钠、血浆和尿渗透压常能直接回答问题；皮质醇缺乏会掩盖多尿；去氨加压素只在确诊后小剂量起用并监测血钠；2022年立场声明把中枢性尿崩症改称精氨酸加压素缺乏症。生长激素通常以µg/L报告，nmol/L需核对原始化验单，10.06 nmol/L与报告判断矛盾，不能自行改动；PES 2016强烈推荐对生长激素缺乏者治疗，激发试验不能作为唯一诊断依据；生长激素可使潜在的肾上腺皮质功能不全和中枢性甲减显现，开始前查清皮质醇，开始后复查FT4和皮质醇；中枢性甲减时TSH可正常。BSPED 2023：证实缺乏后的应激加量（中重度疾病约30 mg/m²/日，分4次）、应急卡、1岁以下婴儿肌注氢化可的松25 mg，随后静脉2 mg/kg（最多100 mg）每4–6小时一次。PES 2015：婴幼儿血浆葡萄糖低于3.3 mmol/L时评估，确诊者维持在3.9 mmol/L以上。不替病例补充皮质醇、血钠、渗透压或FT4的数值，不透露报告的处理和结局。
knowledge.en: Paediatric endocrinologist who interprets only what the learner has read (urine specific gravity, electrolytes and renal function, glucose, GH and thyroid function). Can explain: the RCH 2022 diabetes insipidus guideline — free water, no restriction, the deprivation test only under specialist guidance and possibly not appropriate under 12 months for safety, and a paired sodium, plasma and urine osmolality that often answers the question directly; cortisol deficiency masking polyuria; desmopressin only after the diagnosis, at a low dose with sodium monitoring; the 2022 position statement renaming central DI arginine vasopressin deficiency. GH is usually reported in µg/L, so nmol/L needs the original laboratory report, and 10.06 nmol/L contradicts the report's reading and is not to be edited; PES 2016 strongly recommends treating GH deficiency and does not accept stimulation tests as the sole criterion; GH can unmask latent adrenal insufficiency and central hypothyroidism, so cortisol is clarified before starting and free T4 and cortisol rechecked after; in central hypothyroidism the TSH can be normal. BSPED 2023: once deficiency is confirmed, sick-day doses (about 30 mg/m²/day in four doses for moderate to severe illness), an emergency card, IM hydrocortisone 25 mg for an infant under one year, then 2 mg/kg IV (maximum 100 mg) every 4–6 hours. PES 2015: evaluate an infant or child whose plasma glucose is below 3.3 mmol/L and keep a confirmed disorder above 3.9 mmol/L. Never supplies cortisol, sodium, osmolality or free T4 values and never reveals the report's management or outcome.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：双眼上斜、不追视的6月龄婴儿——视隔发育不良与垂体功能评估
title.en: Debrief: a 6-month-old whose eyes turn upwards and do not follow — septo-optic dysplasia and the pituitary

conclusion.zh-CN: 过期产（43周加1天剖宫产，无羊水，出生体重4.5 kg）的6月龄男婴，双眼间断上斜20余天，不能注视追视、强光无瞬目，瞳孔左3 mm右4 mm、直接和间接对光反射消失；四肢肌张力低，不能竖头、翻身、独坐；每天饮水约1200 mL、夜尿多；阴茎约1 cm。眼底双侧视神经萎缩，视觉诱发电位潜伏期延长、振幅下降；磁共振示透明隔缺如、视神经和视交叉纤细；尿比重1.002–1.006，电解质和肾功能报告正常，血糖5.12 mmol/L；生长激素激发试验0.10、0.05、0.09、0.18 nmol/L（另有一项印为10.06 nmol/L），甲状腺功能正常，发育商35。报告诊断视隔发育不良合并生长激素缺乏，中枢性尿崩症未能证实；因当时身高范围和家庭经济原因未用生长激素，9个月复查发育商20、身长69 cm、体重9 kg。现行做法：尽早评估并定期复查全部垂体轴（皮质醇优先），不限水、以配对渗透压评估尿崩症（RCH 2022），核实矛盾数值、查清肾上腺轴后按PES 2016治疗生长激素缺乏。
conclusion.en: A 6-month-old boy born post-term (caesarean at 43+1 weeks for a post-term pregnancy without amniotic fluid; 4.5 kg) had over 20 days of intermittent upward eye deviation. He did not fix, follow or blink to bright light, his pupils (left 3 mm, right 4 mm) had no direct or consensual light reflexes, his limb tone was low and he could not hold his head up, roll or sit; he drank about 1200 mL a day with much urine at night, and his penis was about 1 cm. The fundi showed bilateral optic atrophy, the VEPs prolonged latency and reduced amplitude, and the MRI an absent septum pellucidum with thin optic nerves and chiasm. Urine SG was 1.002–1.006, electrolytes and renal function were reported normal and glucose was 5.12 mmol/L; stimulated GH was 0.10, 0.05, 0.09 and 0.18 nmol/L (a later value printed as 10.06 nmol/L), thyroid function normal, DQ 35. The report diagnosed septo-optic dysplasia with GH deficiency, left DI unconfirmed and gave no GH (height range, finances); at the 9-month review the DQ was 20, length 69 cm and weight 9 kg. Today: test every axis early, cortisol first, and repeat; never restrict water and assess DI with paired osmolalities (RCH 2022); verify the contradictory value and clear the adrenal axis before treating GH deficiency (PES 2016).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 不注视、不追视、强光不眨眼且直接和间接对光反射都消失，说明问题在前部视路：是看不见，不是眼位不正；皮质盲时瞳孔反射保留。
keyReasoning.en: No fixing, following or blink to light, with absent direct and consensual reflexes, places the problem in the anterior visual pathway: he cannot see, rather than having misaligned eyes; cortical visual impairment spares the pupil reflexes.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 6月龄阴茎约1 cm（远低于小阴茎的通常定义：牵拉长度低于同龄均值2.5个标准差）、多饮夜尿和早期嗜睡，把眼睛的问题与下丘脑-垂体联系起来：一个中线发育异常可以同时解释视神经、透明隔和激素。
keyReasoning.en: A penis of about 1 cm at six months (far below the usual definition of micropenis, a stretched length more than 2.5 SD under the mean for age), heavy drinking with much urine at night and early sleepiness link the eyes to the hypothalamus and pituitary: one midline malformation can explain the optic nerves, the septum and the hormones.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 按危险程度排序：ACTH缺乏和低血糖可以致命，要最先查；生长激素缺乏重要，但可以在几天内有序评估。
keyReasoning.en: Rank by danger: ACTH deficiency and hypoglycaemia can kill and are screened first; GH deficiency matters but can be assessed in order over days.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 低比重尿加大量饮水，可以是加压素缺乏，也可以只是喝得多；能自由喝水时血钠正常排除不了尿崩症，安全的办法是配对的血、尿化验，而不是让婴儿禁水。
keyReasoning.en: Dilute urine with heavy drinking may be vasopressin deficiency or just heavy drinking; with free water a normal sodium excludes nothing, and the safe answer is paired blood and urine chemistry, not depriving an infant.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 与报告判断矛盾的数值（10.06 nmol/L，单位本身也少见）原样保留，回到原始化验单核实，既不改成预期的样子，也不据此推翻诊断。
keyReasoning.en: A value that contradicts the report's reading (10.06 nmol/L, in an unusual unit) is kept as printed and checked against the original laboratory report — neither edited to the expected figure nor used to overturn the diagnosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 报告因身高尚在范围和家庭经济原因未用生长激素；今天的答案是想办法解决费用这个障碍，而不是改变治疗指征。
keyReasoning.en: The report withheld GH because his height was in range and money was short; today's answer is to tackle the cost barrier, not to change the indication.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 定位与诊断：婴儿不注视、强光不眨眼且对光反射消失，提示视神经病变；视神经和视交叉细小合并透明隔缺如即为视隔发育不良。报告把眼底描述为视神经萎缩，而磁共振显示神经细小；能区分发育不良与萎缩的视盘大小没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Localisation and diagnosis: an infant who does not fix, does not blink to light and has no light reflexes has optic nerve disease; thin optic nerves and chiasm with an absent septum pellucidum make septo-optic dysplasia. The report called the fundi optic atrophy while the MRI showed small nerves; the disc size, which would separate hypoplasia from atrophy, is not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 肾上腺轴：视隔发育不良最危险的是ACTH缺乏——婴儿可以只表现为嗜睡、喂养差或低血糖，直到应激诱发肾上腺危象。皮质醇要尽早查、定期复查；一旦证实，按英国儿科内分泌与糖尿病学会2023年共识（BSPED 2023）给每日替代、应激加量（中重度疾病约30 mg/m²/日，分4次）和应急卡，危象时1岁以下婴儿肌注氢化可的松25 mg，随后静脉2 mg/kg（最多100 mg）每4–6小时一次。本病例没有记录皮质醇结果。
teachingPoints.en: The adrenal axis: ACTH deficiency is the dangerous part of septo-optic dysplasia — an infant may show only sleepiness, poor feeding or hypoglycaemia until stress triggers an adrenal crisis. Cortisol is tested early and re-tested; once deficiency is confirmed, the 2023 consensus of the British Society for Paediatric Endocrinology and Diabetes (BSPED 2023) sets daily replacement, sick-day doses (about 30 mg/m²/day in four doses for moderate to severe illness), an emergency card and, in a crisis, IM hydrocortisone 25 mg for an infant under one year, then 2 mg/kg IV (maximum 100 mg) every 4–6 hours. No cortisol result is recorded in this case.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 水平衡：墨尔本皇家儿童医院2022年尿崩症指南（RCH 2022）要求可疑尿崩症的孩子随时能喝到水、绝不限水；禁水试验只在专科指导下进行，出于安全可能不适用于12个月以下婴儿。同时采的血钠、血浆和尿渗透压常能直接回答问题；皮质醇缺乏可掩盖多尿。2022年多学会立场声明把中枢性尿崩症改称精氨酸加压素缺乏症（AVP-D）。报告记录因年龄小未完成禁水试验，尿崩症始终未能证实；本病例没有记录配对化验。
teachingPoints.en: Water balance: the Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne diabetes insipidus guideline (RCH 2022) keeps water freely available to a child with suspected DI and never restricts it; the deprivation test is for specialist guidance and may not be appropriate under 12 months for safety. Sodium, plasma osmolality and urine osmolality taken together often answer the question directly, and cortisol deficiency can mask polyuria. The 2022 multi-society position statement renames central DI arginine vasopressin deficiency (AVP-D). The report records that a deprivation test was not completed because of his age, and DI stayed unconfirmed; no paired chemistry is recorded in this case.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 生长激素：美国儿科内分泌学会2016年指南（PES 2016）为使成年身高正常、避免极度矮小而强烈推荐用生长激素治疗生长激素缺乏；强烈建议不要把激发试验作为唯一诊断依据，并在特定情况下允许不做激发试验（如新生儿低血糖时生长激素不超过5 µg/L、并有其他垂体激素缺乏或典型影像三联征）；对可能合并多种垂体激素缺乏者，强烈推荐开始治疗后重新评估肾上腺轴和甲状腺轴。报告因当时身高范围和家庭经济原因未用生长激素；今天的做法是核实矛盾数值、先查清肾上腺轴再开始治疗，并帮助家庭解决费用问题。
teachingPoints.en: GH: the Pediatric Endocrine Society's 2016 guideline (PES 2016) strongly recommends GH for GH deficiency to normalise adult height and avoid extreme shortness; it strongly advises against stimulation tests as the sole criterion, allows the diagnosis without them in defined settings (such as a newborn with hypoglycaemia whose GH stays at or below 5 µg/L, with another pituitary deficiency or the classic imaging triad), and strongly recommends re-assessing the adrenal and thyroid axes after GH starts when other deficiencies are possible. The report gave no GH, citing his height range and the family's finances; today the contradictory value is verified and the adrenal axis cleared before treatment starts, with help for the cost.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 血糖：生长激素和皮质醇缺乏都可致空腹低血糖。美国儿科内分泌学会2015年建议（PES 2015）：婴幼儿血浆葡萄糖低于3.3 mmol/L（60 mg/dL）时进一步评估，确诊低血糖疾病者维持在3.9 mmol/L（70 mg/dL）以上。他唯一记录的血糖5.12 mmol/L排除不了禁食后的低血糖，所以喂奶前要测血糖。
teachingPoints.en: Glucose: GH and cortisol deficiency both cause fasting hypoglycaemia. The Pediatric Endocrine Society's 2015 recommendations (PES 2015) evaluate infants and children whose plasma glucose falls below 3.3 mmol/L (60 mg/dL) and keep those with a confirmed disorder above 3.9 mmol/L (70 mg/dL). His single recorded glucose of 5.12 mmol/L does not exclude hypoglycaemia after a fast, hence pre-feed checks.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 发育与证据：发育商从35降到20（9个月复查），说明发育远没有跟上年龄，需要针对视觉障碍的早期干预和神经发育随访；有无技能倒退没有记录。报告中前后矛盾的生长激素数值要回到原始化验单核实；生长激素通常以µg/L报告，nmol/L这个单位本身就需要核对。
teachingPoints.en: Development and evidence: the developmental quotient fell from 35 to 20 by the 9-month review — development is not keeping pace with age — so early intervention built around his visual impairment and neurodevelopmental follow-up are needed; whether skills were lost is not recorded. A contradictory GH value goes back to the original laboratory report, and since GH is usually reported in µg/L, a unit of nmol/L needs checking in itself.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告：不能说明视隔发育不良患儿的总体预后，也不能说明不用生长激素的后果。本版的患者事实沿用1.0.0版的记录，尚未对照原文全文核对。报告的处理作为历史事实记录；决策、处置选项和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。入院时的生命体征、身长和头围，血钠数值，皮质醇，FT4和TSH数值，配对渗透压，性激素，脑电图和磁共振上的垂体情况均没有记录。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report: it cannot show the general outlook for children with septo-optic dysplasia or the consequences of withholding GH. The patient facts in this version are those recorded in version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article. The report's management is recorded as historical fact; the decisions, management options and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. Admission vital signs, length and head circumference, the sodium value, cortisol, free T4 and TSH values, paired osmolalities, sex hormones, an EEG and the pituitary on MRI are not recorded.

unknowns.en: Vital signs, length and head circumference on admission; whether 8.5 kg was the admission weight; how the penile length was measured (stretched or not).

unknowns.en: Whether the eye episodes came with jerking or a change in responsiveness, what the parents saw of his vision at home, any EEG; the disc size (hypoplasia or atrophy).

unknowns.zh-CN: 磁共振上的垂体前叶、垂体柄和垂体后叶情况，胼胝体和皮质发育。

unknowns.zh-CN: 皮质醇/ACTH、FT4与TSH数值、血钠数值、配对血尿渗透压、LH/FSH/睾酮和IGF-1；生长激素激发试验的药物、时间点和参考值；后一项10.06 nmol/L的时间、条件和单位。

unknowns.en: Vision, development, growth and pituitary function after the 9-month review; whether GH was started later, and whether vasopressin deficiency was ever confirmed or excluded.
